s: masochism (sexual enjoyment of receiving pain or humiliation)
masochism (joyful wallowing in pain or hardship)
Masochismus.et: Masoch + -ismus, the former named after Austrian novelist Leopold von Sacher-Masoch. Masoch may be a Germanized form of a lost Slavic placename, as Poland and Ukraine used to be part of the Austro-Hungarian empire.
